description: This Java source file defines a test step implementation class for loan re-aging operations within the Fineract project. It contains methods for creating re-aging transactions, undoing them, and verifying that related business events are raised, utilizing Cucumber for behavior-driven testing and Spring for dependency injection.

classes.name: LoanReAgingStepDef
classes.description: A Cucumber step definitions class for handling loan re-aging related test scenarios, extending AbstractStepDef for common test functionality.

methods.name: createReAgingTransaction
methods.description: Creates a loan re-aging transaction using data from a Cucumber data table.

methods.name: createReAgingTransactionByLoanExternalId
methods.description: Creates a loan re-aging transaction identified by the loan external ID, using data from a Cucumber data table.

methods.name: undoReAgingTransaction
methods.description: Undoes the latest loan re-aging transaction.

methods.name: checkLoanReAmortizeBusinessEventCreated
methods.description: Verifies that a LoanReAgeEvent has been raised for the loan.

methods.name: adminFailsToCreateReAgingTransactionWithError
methods.description: Validates that creating a re-aging transaction fails with a specific error message.
